Callout.Name: Disorder After a Match
Callout.Message: Crowd disorder outside a stadium after a match.
Callout.Advisory: Both sets of supporters, bottles thrown, no injuries yet.

Script.Line: It is two sets of supporters and it has been going since the whistle.
Nobody has been hurt yet. That is the whole of it, yet.
We need a line down the middle of that street.

Lines.Approach: Both sets of them, bottles going, and the stewards are outnumbered. Back-up is coming.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
